strategicProblems.result: All six campaigns have four completed chapters on both routes; their stories, maps, unit roles, goals, and required faction mechanics differ.

examples.orcs: Toll crossing: escort forge foreman, shelter refugees, choose bridge assault or courier infiltration, defeat furnace keeper.
examples.fairies: Recover grove wards and living seed; choose grove defense or illusion-assisted stockade attack.
examples.dwarves: Prepare quarry defenses and recover flooded pump; choose surveyor escort or plan infiltration.
examples.undead: Protect burial gate and restore erased names; choose archivist escort or corpse-raising bridge assault.
examples.tideborn: Open wet causeway and restore diverted harbor tide; choose archive infiltration or basin defense.
examples.automata: Reconnect damaged foundry; choose shield-line defense or repair-worker escort.

exampleCoverage.interpretation: The sentence permits an alternative with or. supplementOnly.recommended: During the already planned canonical browser pass, observe one campaign launch, the two authored branch options, one veteran continuation with displayed XP, and one moving convoy/checkpoint. supplementOnly.optionalContentExpansion: A future explicitly labelled refugee caravan or siege convoy would broaden the escort examples; do not present it as an additional gate for this assessment.
supplementOnly.fixtureFailure: The authored-map fixture generator failed before browser. That preparation failure is neither a observed requirement failure nor a successful browser observation.
